items.title: PotatoPie25 Teens
items.creator: ThunderAy
items.description:
Join the potato gang and have lots of fun with YouTuber PotatoPie25's official skin pack!

+ 12 teens you can choose from, whether you wish to be a cool guy, an adventurer, a warrior or a cute girl!
+ 1 FREE skin included!
+ In partnership with PotatoPie25!

items.title: Neon Trend
items.creator: UnderBlocks Studios
items.description:
Neon Trend has arrived in the marketplace! What are you waiting for to buy these neon skins in different colors? Shine among your friends!

-11 Neon Trend
-1 free Neon Trend
by UnderBlocks

items.title: The Ultimate Dragon World
items.creator: ASCENT
items.description:
Become a legendary dragon tamer in this HUGE 2000x2000 custom created world filled with people and magical dragons to fight against and with! Tame your newly hatched baby dragon and conquer the vast world in front of you to become the best dragon trainer that has ever existed!

+ 6 Amazing dragons
+ 2000x2000 world filled with adventure
+ Custom sound effects and music

items.title: Mascots
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Showcase your love of sports with these adorable sports mascots!

- Hand-crafted HD skins
- Includes Tennis Mascot, Basketball Mascot, Soccer Mascot, Golf Mascot, Baseball Mascot, and Football Mascot!
- One skin FREE - yep, gratis, nada, nil! Enjoy!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Puffer Jackets + Big Scarves
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Sometimes the cold is too much for all of us, and we need to wrap up warm in some cozy scarves and big puffy jackets. Keep yourself safe from the cold, harsh air of the mines with the new Big Puffer Style + Big Scarves skin pack!

- 12 cozy skins
- By 57Digital

items.title: Blue Teens Classic
items.creator: 57Digital
items.description:
Feeling blue? Cheer yourself up with this collection of beautiful blue skins!

- Includes six different emotions
- Titles: Zennnn, Eh?, LOL!, OH!, Hmmmm, and Nah!
- By 57Digital

items.title: Ninja Town
items.creator: MobBlocks
items.description: After the beauty of Ninja Village, the adventure continues as we head to Ninja Town. Beware of the Red Clan! These furious ninjas will pick a fight with anyone. An awesome survival spawn to play alone or with friends.

items.title: Robot Teens
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
These teens have been upgraded with the latest in cybernetic-technology! Watch out, their reactions are super human and they're now pros at everything!

- 12 futuristic skins
- Wide variety of designs including robots, cyborgs, and androids!

items.title: Bedwars Gladiators
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Want to show the world who the best Bedwars player is? Then this pack is for you! Put on your Bedwars outfits and get your wins. Show who is the king and the best gladiator of the current war of beds!

+ 1 free skin
+ 20 Bedwars skins

items.title: Slime Mobs
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Uh oh, it looks like these mobs have turned into slimes! Good thing these glass containers are keeping them safe... well, as long as they don't break at least!

- Play as Creeper, Skeleton, Enderman and more in their slime form!
- Perfect for standing out in the crowd!

items.title: Goats
items.creator: Razzleberries
items.description:
Do you like goats? You're in for a real treat! Put on your best goat outfit and show your friends who the real G.O.A.T is!
+ 10 goat skins
+ 1 free skin

items.title: Car Town
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Zoom through roads in different environments and have your very own car collection in Car Town! Role play with friends in this game where you create your own story. Expand, upgrade and win races around the different tracks on the island.

- 4 different islands
- A wide variety of 36 vehicles to race in
- Includes 4 racer skins
- Role play map with lots of interactable NPCs

items.title: Luxury Villa on the Water
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Who has never dreamt of living in a seaside villa? Live the life of a millionaire in this gorgeous villa with it's yacht and helicopter in this survival spawn.

- Chest room
- Growing room
- Cinema
- Arcade room

items.title: Apexium
items.creator: Netherpixel
items.description:
Scientists kept pushing the boundaries in robotic experiments which resulted in chaos as robots take over the laboratory! Explore the laboratory, complete the training and all the tasks and find out what lies beyond darkness.

- 4 levels
- 5 Enemies, 1 Boss
- Includes 4 incredible skins

items.title: Dino Teens
items.creator: Cynosia
items.description:
Go back in time and be a dinosaur! There are lots of color swatches for you to enjoy. Great for roleplay and scaring your friends!

+ 10 skins
+ Great for roleplay
+ Lots of color options
+ Made by Artifact Studios

items.title: SkyBlock Rainbows
items.creator: The Lucky Petals
items.description:
These skins are super cute and colorful! Equip a rainbow skin for your skyblock world!

- 13 skyblock skins

items.title: Block Mobs 2 HD Skin Pack
items.creator: CupcakeBrianna
items.description:
Our favorite blocky imposters are back and ready to sneak up on you! Includes nine new block textures with mob faces to truly trick your friends. Be a wooden creeper, obsidian enderman, gold blaze, and more!

+ 9 HD skins
+ By CupcakeBrianna

items.title: Glow Demons
items.creator: Nitric Concepts
items.description: The demons glow among us!

items.title: Ender Agents
items.creator: PixelOneUp
items.description: Calling all agents! Choose your favorite ender agent to get the mission done. Go undercover with these unique skins!

items.title: Survive 24 Hours
items.creator: TNTgames
items.description:
The bunker is under siege by the mutant horde. Hack and slash your way through the night, but be ready to die countless times trying. Master all new weapons and prove you are able to survive 24 hours.

-Custom weapons
-Multiplayer friendly
-Adjustable difficulty
-Epic enemies and boss fight
-Custom soundtrack

items.title: Anime Heroes Vs. Villians
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
You know what makes a great hero? An equally great villain! Choose the light or the dark side and create your own epic story!

- 10 Anime-inspired goodies and baddies!
- Licensed by The Pocalypse Studios and published by BLOCKLAB Studios.

items.title: Biome Teens
items.creator: BLOCKLAB Studios
items.description:
The trendiest biome skins are here! There's a huge variety to pick from and you can be any stylish teen you want! Whether you like the forest, snowy ice, or red mushroom biomes, we've got you covered!

- 8 HD skins
- 100% AWESOME
- Published by BLOCKLAB Studios under license from UniDesigns.

items.title: TNT Run Ultimate
items.creator: Dig Down Studios
items.description: Battle your friends in an arena where every block you stand on begins to fall. In this version there are countless options and game modes to choose from that keeps every game exciting. Select from arena size, amount of layers, block effects, potion effects, TNT throwables, and more. Multiplayer Only.

items.title: Dino Onesies
items.creator: Cypress Games
items.description:
Rawr! Are they scary or are they cute? Equip these awesome dinosaur skins now and grab the attention of all your friends!

+ 12 skins
+ 2 FREE!
+ Perfect for teens
+ Perfect for roleplay
